items.text:
I can completely relate to this game, pretty much what I think on any date I've been on, its a full on story driven experience, the dialogue is good and the music too
There's a few issues with it
- the sound options are ok, the music sometimes drowns out what your character is saying, but that could be because i have really bad hearing, it works better for me through headphones
-some of the icons which are used for selecting things, i.e pouring wine or eating bread are a little confusing, I think it would have been better to just have words rather than pictures for selecting or maybe they should be bigger icons.
god i sound like i'm 300 years old or something

other than that its fairly funny to listen to this guy saying he wants to shag his date even though she hasn't turned up, I got this in a sale, and that's what I recommend, get it when its on offer, I paid out 40 pence or something for it.
items.text_zh:
我完全能对这款游戏产生共鸣，基本上就是我在任何一次约会中会有的想法，它是一场完整的剧情驱动体验，对话不错，音乐也是
它有几个问题
- 声音选项还行，音乐有时会盖过你的角色在说什么，但那可能是因为我听力真的很差，用耳机对我来说效果更好
- 有些用来选择东西的图标，比如倒酒或吃面包，有点让人困惑，我觉得用文字而不是图片来选择会更好，或者也许它们应该做成更大的图标。
god，我听起来像300岁似的

除此之外，听这家伙说他想上他的约会对象，尽管她根本没出现，还挺好笑的，我是打折时买的，这就是我的推荐，等它打折时再买，我大概花了40便士还是多少买的。
